The 2026 edition runs across two days in late October, combining technical deep dives with workshops led by practitioners rather than vendors. For teams travelling to Torremolinos, accommodation sits within walking distance of the venue, and most international attendees arrive via Málaga airport, roughly twenty minutes away. Uphill Conf is a two-day frontend and web development conference held in Bern, Switzerland. The 2027 edition takes place at the end of April and follows the format the organisers have refined over several years: a single track, a deliberately capped audience, and speakers chosen for depth rather than name recognition. Content focuses on modern web platform work, covering frameworks, performance, accessibility and the architectural decisions behind large frontend codebases. The single-track structure means every attendee sees the same talks, which the organisers argue produces better hallway conversations than a fragmented multi-track schedule. Bern offers a compact, walkable setting with reliable rail connections from Zurich and Geneva airports, making it accessible for attendees travelling from across Europe. The conference draws a mix of Swiss engineering teams and international developers, and the smaller scale keeps it closer to a community gathering than a trade event. Event organisers running conferences in Switzerland can use Hoperfy to manage attendee accommodation and speaker housing.

Agile Testing Days is one of Europe's longest-running conferences dedicated to software testing and quality engineering, held annually in Potsdam near Berlin. The 2026 edition runs across four days in November, combining tutorials, conference sessions and workshops. The programme covers test automation, exploratory testing, quality strategy, and the evolving role of testers within agile and DevOps teams. What distinguishes the event is its emphasis on practitioner experience over theory, with many sessions delivered by testers presenting work from their own organisations rather than consultants selling methodology. The conference attracts QA engineers, test architects, engineering managers and developers from across Europe, and typically runs at several hundred attendees. Potsdam sits directly outside Berlin with frequent rail connections, and most international attendees fly into Berlin Brandenburg airport. The multi-day format means nearly all attendees require accommodation for the full week. DITA Europe is a specialist conference focused on structured content, technical documentation and the DITA standard, held in Helsinki in February 2027. The event brings together technical writers, content strategists, documentation managers and the tooling vendors that serve them. Sessions cover content reuse, localisation workflows, single-sourcing strategy, and the practical challenges of migrating legacy documentation into structured formats. The audience skews towards enterprise documentation teams in software, manufacturing and medical device industries, where regulatory requirements make structured content management a necessity rather than a preference. DITA Europe is deliberately small compared to general content conferences, which keeps the technical level high and makes it useful for teams facing specific implementation problems. Helsinki is well connected to the rest of Europe through Helsinki-Vantaa airport, and the February timing means most attendees book accommodation close to the venue rather than commuting.
